## TemplateEngine.compileBlockKeyboards() method

Compiles keyboard blocks from a template into executable functions.

**Signature:**

```typescript
static compileBlockKeyboards(template: string, baseBlocks?: ReturnType<typeof TemplateEngine._processBaseBlocks>): {
        [baseId: string]: {
            [lang: string]: {
                inline?: (data?: Record<string, any>) => string[];
                bottom?: (data?: Record<string, any>) => string[];
            };
        };
    };
```

Compiled keyboard functions organized by base ID, language, and mode

## Remarks

This method parses `<keyboard>` blocks from the template and compiles them into functions that generate button label arrays. The result is organized by base ID and language, with separate `inline` and `bottom` keyboard modes. Comma-separated labels are split into individual button strings.

Processing pipeline (in order, per keyboard label): 1. `_processScriptBlocks` – converts `<script>` blocks into executable expressions 2. `_processMapBlocks` – converts `<map>` blocks into array map expressions 3. `_processSwitchBlocks` – converts `<switch>` blocks into switch expressions 4. `_processScopeExec` – evaluates scope execution blocks (implementation-defined) 5. `_processScopeVariables` – resolves scope variables (implementation-defined) 6. `_compileToFunction(processedLabels, true)` – produces the final render function

Notes: - Keyboard content is split by commas into individual labels. - Escaped commas with double backslash (`\\,`<!-- -->) are preserved as literal commas. - Each label is processed independently through the pipeline.

Output shape: - First level key: `baseId` (from `<base id="...">`<!-- -->, or `"default"` if omitted) - Second level key: `lang` (from `<keyboard lang="...">`<!-- -->, or `"default"` if omitted) - Third level key: `mode`<!-- -->: - `inline` (default) - `bottom` - Value: `(data?: Record<string, any>) => string[]`

## Example


```typescript
const template = `
  <base>
    <keyboard>Yes, No, {{action}}</keyboard>
    <keyboard type="bottom">Menu, Help</keyboard>
  </base>
`;
const keyboards = TemplateEngine.compileBlockKeyboards(template);
const inline = keyboards.default?.default?.inline?.({ action: 'Cancel' });
// Result: ['Yes', 'No', 'Cancel']
```
